messages.subject: Remote error when running spatialDGMM
parts:
Hello everyone,

I am consistently getting the same error every time I try to run spatialDGMM in Cardinal v3.0.1 (I also get this with a previous version of Cardinal though) with the following command:

dgmm.neg.k10 <- spatialDGMM(AgNP_neg_peaks2,r=1, k=10, method="adaptive")

Here is the error:

r= 1, k = 10, feature =  ..Error: BiocParallel errors

  1 remote errors, element index: 14

  6 unevaluated and other errors

  first remote error:

Error in if (E$loglik > loglik_a) {: missing value where TRUE/FALSE needed

In addition: Warning messages:

1: Quick-TRANSfer stage steps exceeded maximum (= 361400) 

2: Quick-TRANSfer stage steps exceeded maximum (= 329150) 

3: Quick-TRANSfer stage steps exceeded maximum (= 329150) 

4: Quick-TRANSfer stage steps exceeded maximum (= 329150) 

5: Quick-TRANSfer stage steps exceeded maximum (= 329150) 

6: Quick-TRANSfer stage steps exceeded maximum (= 361400) 

7: Quick-TRANSfer stage steps exceeded maximum (= 361400) 

I tried also running the command after running register(SerialParam()) but the error remained the same and there.  I consistently get the error at feature 1373.

Has anyone seen this error when running SpatialDGMM?  I have seen this error pop up numerous times in this group, but never in this context and so far everything I have tried has failed to fix the issue.  SessionInfo() is provided below.

Thanks,

Nadia

messages.author: 6033d3c0e7d242fa
messages.subject: Re: Remote error when running spatialDGMM
parts:
When you plot the ion image for that feature, does it look decent?

Some features will not have the data quality to support a good segmentation and may result in NaN log-likelihoods like this.

I have tried to have most methods fail gracefully in such situations, but looks like I'll need to handle a few more such situations.

For now, the best thing to do would be to remove any problematic features and run the analysis again without them. Alternatively, you could try requesting fewer segments and see if that helps.

-Kylie

Hi Kylie,

Thank you for responding!  It doesn't look great in my opinion, but I don't know how bad the quality would need to be for the segmentation to fail.   I requested 5 segments and that did work, whereas requesting 10, 15, and up failed.  So perhaps that is the issue.  I'll try removing this feature and hopefully, then it will work.  I'll report back shortly.

Thanks,
Nadia
